scope: Authorized ROS wrapper scheduling/trajectory synchronization interface repair only. No simulation started by this agent. Upstream TP snapshot is unchanged; patch applies only to Docker copied build tree.

baseline.finding: Existing30Hz-capped native IMU propagation is called only from ROS imuCallback. ROS spin_some shares the main thread with processFrame and debug-image publishing, so visual processing/join stalls defer real IMU ingestion/prediction. Evidence supports native callback scheduling/producer-stamp lag; no direct per-function profiler yet isolates the single fault stall or proves the entire slowdown cause.

source_proof.fact: Actual parameter passed to Publisher; main serially spins ROS then processFrame/display/publishImages.
Same callback pushes real IMU into estimator then invokes native realtimePredictAndPublish using original timestamp.
processFrame synchronously detects/matches and joins prior optimisation; a long call blocks next spin_some even though optimisation/publishing have worker threads.
Measurement queues implement push/pop under pthread mutex; existing Realsense node directly feeds queues from sensor callbacks.
trajectoryLocked_ is atomic_bool, not plain bool. check-then-store in CPP is not atomic mutual exclusion.
Trajectory explicitly requires caller synchronization; no internal mutex.
Propagation/update gate is check-then-store atomic_bool; path getState reads outside that gate. Must cover both getter sites with real short locks.
Source body subscription/publisher depth1; state copied and immediately republished with original acquisition stamp, no Python backlog queue or latest-time stamping.

implementation.ingress: SingleThreadedExecutor for entire node on dedicated ingress thread. Image/IMU callbacks stay mutually serial; no MultiThreadedExecutor/default-group concurrency.
implementation.main: Original estimator.processFrame/display/publishImages stay on main thread. No visual pipeline algorithm or budget change.
implementation.trajectory: Real std::mutex covers addImuMeasurement, optimized update, and both getState sites. IMU uses nonblocking try_lock and retains real samples when busy; graph update uses lock_guard; each path getter uses individual short lock. ROS publications remain outside trajectory mutex.
implementation.lifecycle: Normal and exceptional visual exits cancel executor, join ingress, then subscriber.shutdown before stack destruction. Callback exception_ptr read only after join. Original atomic shutdown flag retained.
implementation.diagnostics: At most once every 5 steady seconds: main processFrame max/true-call mean; successful IMU output logs real acquisition stamp, propagation method entry steady clock, actual propagated state stamp, postpublish steady clock. Entry time is not DDS receipt; no log value feeds estimator/control.
